finding: Attempt 05 scorer accepted both markers anywhere and did not validate their label mapping; it also treated a completed negative adoption gate as a test process failure.
correction: Score only the final answer after the last </think> marker; require an anchored exact ALPHA=<expected>; BETA=<expected> mapping. Keep completion of all six preregistered runs distinct from the adoption decision.
regressions: correct mapping in reasoning with wrong final mapping rejected

validation.scope: Linux Release test suite; CPU-only; no inference server, GPU request, model load or benchmark; full suite may report unrelated environment-dependent failures

decisionRule: No adoption unless the correctly scored results meet the preregistered quality and throughput gates. Existing corrected attempt 05 already fails those gates; this change validates scorer behavior only and does not justify another GPU run.
